question: Where can I get the public grants awarded to energy projects in the United States, with beneficiary, project, amount, programme, location and date?

answer.summary: USAspending.gov is the official register of federal grants: each award has recipient, FAIN, Assistance Listing and funding opportunity, net obligation, outlays (since FY2022), action date and place of performance (API from FY2008, archives from FY2001). Energy projects must be filtered by programme (e.g. DOE 81.254, USDA 10.868). DOE programme pages separate selections from awards (GRIP: 60 awarded, 44 selected). State grants are separate, e.g. NYSERDA's solar incentives on data.ny.gov.
main_caveats: Award Amount in USAspending is the net obligation; selections announced by DOE are not obligations and payments (outlays) are a separate field reported only since FY2022.
DOE terminated 321 awards (223 projects) announced 2025-10-02; terminated awards remain in USAspending with their transaction history.
Grants (types 02-05) must be separated from loans and other assistance; DOE research cooperative agreements are not energy projects.
State-funded grants (e.g. NYSERDA) are outside USAspending and vary by state.
answer.confidence_reason: USAspending API, award detail, transactions and archive tested; definitions read in its data dictionary; DOE list reconciled with one award. State coverage sampled (New York only).

attributes.note: Recipient name, UEI and parent entity per award (USAspending); applicant/selectee in DOE's GRIP table.
Award description and FAIN identify the funded work; DOE lists project names. Energy projects are not flagged as such.
attributes.gap_note: USAspending has no energy-project flag or project ID separate from the award; selection by Assistance Listing or description text is needed (checked in data dictionary and award records).

attributes.note: USD net obligation, account obligation and outlays separated; DOE shows selected federal cost share; NYSERDA incentive per project.
Assistance Listing number/title and funding opportunity per award; GRIP sub-programme; NYSERDA solicitation.
Recipient address and primary place of performance (city, county, ZIP) are separate fields; NYSERDA gives project city, ZIP and tract.
attributes.gap_note: Place of performance is the predominant performance location and can equal the recipient's office (DEGD0000964 Helena, MT vs project in MT/ND); no project coordinates in USAspending.

attributes.note: ActionDate/date_signed of the New Award transaction, distinct from period-of-performance start and outlay timing.

how_to_use.example_request: curl -s -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data '{"filters":{"award_type_codes":["02","03","04","05"],"program_numbers":["81.254"],"time_period":[{"start_date":"2007-10-01","end_date":"2026-09-30"}]},"fields":["Award ID","Award Amount","Total Outlays","Start Date","Place of Performance State Code","Place of Performance Zip5","Recipient Location","Assistance Listings","generated_internal_id"],"limit":2,"page":1,"sort":"Award Amount","order":"desc"}' https://api.usaspending.gov/api/v2/search/spending_by_award/
how_to_use.example_result: {"Award ID": "DEGD0000964", "Award Amount": 695478430.0, "Total Outlays": 0.0, "Start Date": "2025-01-01", "Place of Performance State Code": "MT", "Place of Performance Zip5": "59601", "Assistance Listings": [{"cfda_number": "81.254", ...}]} (recipient omitted)
steps: Count first with search/spending_by_award_count/ (grants vs loans vs direct payments).

Filter energy programmes by Assistance Listing (program_numbers), e.g. 81.254 (437 grant awards), 81.041 State Energy Program (854), USDA 10.868 Rural Energy for America (28,601) for 2007-10-01 to 2026-09-30; or by awarding agency.
Open awards/{generated_unique_award_id}/ for date_signed, total_obligation, total_outlay, funding_opportunity and place_of_performance; transactions/ for the obligation history.
For full fiscal years use bulk_download/list_monthly_files/ (DOE FY2026: FY2026_089_Assistance_Full_20261106.zip, 10,299 transaction rows, 116 columns).
reading_traps: A time_period filter selects awards with transactions in the period, so old awards with FY2026 modifications are included (top DOE result started 2021).
Award Amount (total_obligation) differs from total_account_obligation and total_outlay: e.g. DENE0009040 total_obligation 921,717,024 vs account obligation 1,083,615,571.33 vs outlay 612,283,407.52.
Place of performance can be the recipient's office city rather than the project site: DEGD0000964 is recorded in Helena, MT (zip 59601) while DOE lists the project in MT and ND.
Archive rows are transactions, not awards: the DOE FY2026 file has 10,299 rows including 1,146 negative obligations and loans/other types.
DOE science and research cooperative agreements are also type 05 grants; energy projects must be selected by programme or description.
Start Date in search results is the period-of-performance start, not the award date (DEGD0000964: action_date 2024-12-11, start 2025-01-01).

evidence.claim: API date limit and longer history through downloads
evidence.quote: For searches, time period start and end dates are currently limited to an earliest date of 2007-10-01.  For data going back to 2000-10-01, use either the Custom Award Download feature on the website or one of our download or bulk_download API endpoints
The name of the city where the predominant performance of the award will be accomplished.

steps: Match awarded rows to USAspending by programme 81.254 and project description to get FAIN, obligation and dates.
reading_traps: Federal Cost Share is the selected amount; for the North Plains Connector row DOE lists $700,000,000 while USAspending shows 695,478,430 after a de-obligation of 4,521,570 on 2026-09-24.
'Selected' rows are not awards: the funding opportunity treats selection as the start of negotiations.
Statuses reflect December 2024; DOE announced on 2025-10-02 the termination of 321 awards (223 projects) across several offices without a list on that page.
